name: H3 Diff-Aid-style text row gain
plain: Scales only the text rows of H3's packed sequence just before chosen blocks, which raises or lowers text features in those blocks. It has no trained weights, unlike the Diff-Aid idea it adapts. The node's own text says no quality gain has been established.
math:
Rows where tag mod 3 = 1 are text. Before each chosen block: h_text ← h_text·(1 + s·g(σ)·w_i).
g = 1 inside [sigma_start, sigma_end] (σ relative to the schedule max), optional smoothstep ramp.
w_i = 1, or a linear or exponential fall to token_tail along the tokens. cond_only skips any call not confirmed as conditional.
